source_facts.fact: Every parent, sector child, ROlower and WB mem_fetch gets a distinct existing global UID; no copied UID or narrowed generation
128B parent -> four actual32B requesters, each original_mf points at parent; m_request_tracker tracks children
Partition pops actual requester child, no parent aggregation here; external fixture keeps parent until4children consumed
One common D512 descriptor for every actual requester pointer, generation checked; parent is not additional descriptor
All merges set permanent reuse_seen, including siblings generated from same128Bparent; no future reuse oracle
Detach requires !reuse_seen and unresolved required sector; fullparent sibling merges prevent detaching A0
Only required minus issued-or-ready may issue; merged A0 duplicate has no new missing sector
Actual ROlower uses NULL origin, own UID, explicit RO marker and landing handle/generation; no requester descriptor of its own
WB packet existing UID binds directory row/incarnation via m_ft_pending; no parent/RO UID substitution
Paid WB readout precedes actual loweraccept; retained WB->TVD_INFLIGHT only without pins; independent packet preserves snapshot
Costed one completion CAM/physical cycle matches WB UID first; set WB_COMPLETE; defer role/state transition if pinned
After actual bank grant+ICNT enqueue, decrement reader/unpin; both WB and TVD roles finalize TVD_VALID on done
